description: Three-bay timber town archway (paifang): four red columns on carved drum bases with braces, tall centre bay with blank gold-framed plaque and bracket set, lower side bays with jade panels, curved tile roofs with upturned eaves.
size_note: Approx. 8.2 x 1.8 x 5.9 m; centre opening 2.3 m wide.
modeling_method: ten concept sketches drawn first, loaded as reference images, then modelled from the shared design spec; ten views rendered from the same model
